tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rta mgrin yang gsang brgyud 'debs zhal bskong ni/ phyi ltar dge mtshan du mas dpal gyis phyug /nang ltar gsang chen rdo rje'i pho brang che/ /gsang ba mnyam nyid chen po'i mkha' klong du/ /yab rje dbang sdud snying po la༞ /phun tshogs longs sku'i gzhal med khang bzang cher/ /dbang gi mtshan can thugs sras grub pa'i dbang / /rim gnyis bdud rtsi zil mngar rtags rol ba'i/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen la༞ /bkra shis dge mtshan du ma'i srid pa'i gnas/ /bslab gsum rin chen rgyan gyis mngon par mtho/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i ded dpon sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan la༞ /'chi med dbang gi dga' tshal dam pa ru/ /gsang gsum lha yi 'khor lor rtag tu gzigs/ /pad+ma ka ra slar byon sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang theg chen dbang sdud la༞ /phun tshogs rta bdun lam gyi nam mkha' la/ /nam bkra'i 'od lnga'i gur khang zhal yas cher/ /ḍā ki tshogs kyi rje bo sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la༞ /'dzam gling phun tshogs du ma'i dpal 'bar bar/ /lung rtogs chos kyi snang byed zer phreng 'gyed/ /phan bde'i pad tshal bzhad pa'i gnyen gcig pu/ /skyabs mchog kun dga' snying po la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 'di rab dngas dad pa yis/ /rnyog ma dang bral chu mtsho las/ /byung ba'i ngang mo'i dbyangs chung 'di/ /chos 'dod sngags pa phrin las kyis/ /zil non lo la sbyar ba'i dges/ /dbang chen go 'phang myur thob shog /zhal dro/ maṅgalaṃ/ bkra shis// // sa chen rdo rje 'chang dbang kun blo'i zhabs/ /grub dbang 'jigs bral yab rje dbang gi mtshan/ /gang gi thugs sras ngag dbang kun rin la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ /snyan rgyud mnga' bdag kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / /pad+ma dbang chen theg chen maṅga'i mtshan/ /ngag dbang kun bsod rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /rnam dag༞ thugs rjes༞ /oṃ sarba༞ / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rta mgrin yang gsang brgyud 'debs zhal skong /
